Licensing rounds

The North Sea Transition Authority (NSTA) runs offshore licensing rounds under the Petroleum Act 1998. Each round invites applications for Seaward Production Licences over blocks on offer, and awards are made following assessment of the work programmes offered.

34th Offshore Licensing Round

The 34th Offshore Licensing Round was announced on 2 September 2026, offering 310 blocks and part-blocks across the North Sea, the West of Shetland and the East Irish Sea.

The data package for the 34th Round, including the blocks on offer and the featured prospects, is available through the National Data Repository from 16 September 2026.

Applications for the 34th Offshore Licensing Round must be submitted through the UK Energy Portal by 13:00 on 14 January 2027.

The NSTA expects to make the first tranche of licence offers in the summer of 2027, subject to the completion of the Habitats Regulations Assessment.

33rd Offshore Licensing Round

The 33rd Offshore Licensing Round closed to applications on 12 January 2023. The NSTA made 82 offers in the first tranche on 30 May 2023 and a further 27 in the second tranche on 31 October 2023.

Previous rounds

Datasets for previous offshore petroleum licensing rounds, including blocks on offer and provisional awards, are published on the NSTA Open Data portal.
